theorem_title: Polynomial color resources remain polynomial after driver assembly
theorem_natural_language_statement:
If the selected-color resource-need function is polynomial in input length and value bound, then the full resource-need function obtained by adding the concrete finite-color driver is polynomial as well.

This closure property lets the finite color driver inherit the polynomial resource guarantees of its concrete color solver.
